prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1217; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's alright.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection on the main road in Sugar Land. I had a green light, or at least I'm pretty sure it was green.

Q: What happened next?

A: A car came from my right side, from the cross street. It didn't stop. It hit the passenger side of my vehicle, right near the middle of the door.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: Not really. I heard the tires first, then there was a bang and my car spun a little toward the curb.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: How are you feeling physically since the collision?

A: My right shoulder is pretty bad. It hurts when I lift anything, and I can't sleep on that side. I went to urgent care that same afternoon and they said it might be a strain or something worse, so I'm waiting on a follow-up.

Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?

A: No, I didn't hit my head. I was shaken up, but I stayed conscious the whole time.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Just that I'm hoping this gets sorted out quickly, because I can't work the way I usually do right now.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Alright, thanks.
